title: Cozy Village Logic Grid Puzzles for Adults

village.name: Thistledown
village.tagline: A quiet village at the forest edge, where every path has a story.
village.story: At the edge of an ancient wood sits Thistledown, a village of slate roofs, garden gates, and lanes that disappear beneath the trees. The residents know which mushrooms are safe, which bells ring in fog, and which stories are better left untold. Yet mysteries keep crossing the village green, leaving only clues for the patient observer.
village.visual: a cozy English woodland village, cottages, ancient trees, village green

puzzles.intro: A cargo manifest vanished when a painted narrowboat paused at Thistledown. A wet mooring knot and an unfamiliar crate mark suggested that one delivery was never meant to be recorded.
A signed literary letter disappeared during an evening at the Thistledown bookshop. A creased dust jacket and a fountain-pen blot were found beside the empty frame.

The antique brooch used in the Thistledown play disappeared between dress rehearsal and curtain-up. A bent costume pin and a revised stage list suggested that the prop cupboard was not as secure as everyone claimed.

The Thistledown clock stopped before the founders' ceremony, and its heavy winding key was gone. Fresh oil on the stair rail and a folded maintenance card showed that someone had climbed higher than they admitted.
A rare skein of silver alpaca yarn disappeared during the Thistledown knitting retreat. A dye-stained label and a half-finished swatch were left near the empty display basket.
The small silver trophy at the Thistledown angling club vanished before the riverside picnic. A wet measuring tape and a torn permit corner were found in the weighing hut.
Before the weekly Thistledown pub quiz, the sealed final-question card vanished from the quizmaster's box. A chalk mark, a folded score sheet, and a misplaced dart gave the teams plenty to explain.
A silver medal disappeared from the Thistledown honey exhibition while the judges sampled the final jars. A wax flake, a bent display pin, and one swapped tasting spoon narrowed the search.
A rare orchid vanished from the Thistledown greenhouse during the spring open day. Damp footprints, a loosened plant label, and a folded sheet of tissue paper marked its route.
The brass seal used on Thistledown historical certificates disappeared before the annual lecture. A red wax crumb and a misfiled membership card were found at the secretary's desk.
The winning charcoal sketch at the Thistledown art society was replaced with an unfinished study. A smudged fixative card and a broken frame pin revealed the exchange.
The woven crown for the Thistledown harvest supper disappeared from its stand. A barley stem and a length of green thread were discovered near the kitchen passage.
A Roman coin disappeared from the small Thistledown museum during a school visit. A cotton glove and a shifted display card showed that the cabinet had been opened with care.
The Thistledown choir's festival solo score vanished during rehearsal. A folded hymn sheet, a snapped pencil, and a misplaced robe suggested that someone wanted the performance delayed.
